newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean quarterly unemployment at 5.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Chilean quarterly unemployment at 5.4 percent.

text.p: Unemployment in Chile was unchanged at 5.4 percent in the November-to-January quarter versus the last three months of 1996, the government reported.
The rate was within most forecasts and well below the 7.0 percent unemployment in the three months up to January 1996.

The capital Santiago and the southern Eighth Region posted the highest jobless rates, both at 6.4 percent, followed by the Fifth Region, which includes Valparaiso and Vina del Mar, at 6.1 percent, said the National Statistics Institute.
The Chilean economy added 95,990 jobs in the November-to- January quarter, bringing the total to 5,302,640, said the institute.
Youth unemployment, which has stayed stubbornly high despite strong economic growth overall, was about even at 12.9 percent in the November-to-January period, it said.
